scope: Broaden the source inventory from DWG/DXF codecs to raw SAT/SAB parsers and shape-conversion stacks; inspect current ACadRust release claims and issue reports; refine optional semantic-oracle readiness.

method.kind: Static review of primary project documentation, source repositories, and issue reports
method.sourcePinning: GitHub main/master pages and active issue trackers are mutable; capture exact commit/release, package hash, platform, options, and relevant issue state before any runtime comparison.
method.evidenceRule: Separate container extraction, exact handle/page/owner association, raw SAT/SAB parsing, complete topology conversion, kernel lineage, known-answer semantics, and native consumer acceptance. A different parser is not automatically a different kernel; a self-roundtrip is not an independent semantic oracle.

role: restricted analytic geometry converter using CadQuery/OpenCascade
candidates.evidence: The project describes itself as experimental and supports documented SAT versions 105/400/600/700 plus selected SAB/ASM profiles. Its SAB table lists ACIS BinaryFile4 21800 and selected ASM BinaryFile4 versions; ASM BinaryFile8 is only synthetically framed. Unknown records remain raw with diagnostics; unsupported conversion raises rather than returning a partial body. Active references must resolve in the parsed table. Opaque history is retained but its content/terminal framing is not validated. It consumes extracted SAT/SAB bytes, not a DWG/AcDs container.
doesNotEstablish: complete B-rep conversion for arbitrary producers
candidates.planUse: Optional parser/converter only after local handle/page/owner closure and exact profile admission. Pin the version; require complete body inventory, no unsupported required topology, closed valid shapes, independently authored metrics, and explicit kernel lineage.

candidates.evidence: The add-on documents importing SAT/SAB and DXF 3D solids through native Part or STEP conversion routes. Its listed limits include unsupported blending surfaces, some helix curves, and law-defined interpolated curves/surfaces without spline data; SAT/SAB export is not supported.
doesNotEstablish: a second kernel lineage from FreeCAD/OCCT
candidates.planUse: Optional exploratory route after exact source and platform preflight. Record direct Part import separately from STEP translation and do not treat it as an independent-kernel vote.

candidates.project: Open CASCADE ACIS exchange components / CAD Assistant
candidates.evidence: The public OCCT components preview lists ACIS SAT/SAB import-export as an extended commercial component. CAD Assistant advertises ACIS import through commercial XDE components and says model export/conversion is restricted.
doesNotEstablish: availability in a normal FreeCAD/OCCT installation
export or round-trip capability in CAD Assistant
user entitlement or local platform availability
candidates.planUse: Use only with user-provided/entitled exact build after local architecture/component/profile preflight. Never purchase/install automatically or make it a required dependency.

role: same implementation lineage across branded consumers
candidates.evidence: The current project README advertises R12-R2018+ DWG/DXF read/write but qualifies that entity availability varies by version. Current open reports include an AC1032 MLeader-context decode regression on 0.6.4 (#134), orphan entities being re-homed into modelspace (#133), an AC1024 associative dependency layout (#135), and binary DXF code-width errors (#136). Earlier malformed-input reports #123/#124 describe count inflation/allocation failure and a header panic on 0.6.3; #123 has a maintainer-linked bounds-fix commit, so that report alone is not evidence the issue persists in the current release. Tests demonstrate synthetic marker-frame checks and an implementation-self-roundtripped generated cube, not independent B-rep semantics.
doesNotEstablish: current broad read compatibility from the matrix alone
correct owner graph or error handling in all releases
a separate parser lineage for OpenCADStudio or known forks/wrappers
candidates.planUse: Pin exact release/source SHA and relevant issue state before a scoped optional run. Compare handle-level typed/raw/skipped disposition, owner graph, diagnostics, malformed-input behavior, output reopen and independent expected geometry. Do not use as a normative oracle or per-slice required dependency.

implementationReadinessChanges: Close local raw-frame/typed-peer/owner and AcDs handle/page association before passing payloads to any external ACIS reader.
Probe exact inner SAT/SAB signature and save version before selecting cq-acis; if outside documented admission, record NOT_APPLICABLE rather than infer support or fall back silently.

For an admitted cq-acis case, require full record/reference/body coverage, no unsupported required topology, valid closed shapes, and independent analytic metrics for bounds, area/volume, centroid, units, orientation, and transform.
Keep parser lineage and geometry-kernel lineage separate. cq-acis, InventorLoader, FreeCAD, and CAD Assistant all use OCCT-derived geometry; two frontends do not create two independent-kernel votes.
Keep commercial ACIS components optional and entitlement-driven; never assume stock FreeCAD includes them or that CAD Assistant can export/convert.

Treat ACadRust current issue reports as version-bound test-selection evidence. Pin the exact build, distinguish the fixed or still-open state of older reports, and retain owner-graph and malformed-input checks in any optional comparison.
Keep per-slice validation to the affected strict build, focused fast CTest, lc3_compat_check, and git diff --check; run peer/native/kernel comparisons only at the composed checkpoint.
